notes: A pursuing zombie you outrun to an escape exit, losing if it catches you, is Survival's asymmetric chase rather than a runner — forward motion is the player's and the run terminates, so Infinite Runner is out; the ramps and parkour are real enough to name Obby & Platformer second, but it does not lead and so does not import its genre-wide P6. None of Survival's typical shapes describes the answer's abandoned city of streets, rooftops, ramps and parkour obstacles, so I took traversal-city from the wider catalogue — it is that space almost verbatim, with the streets below as the fallback route — over warren-looping, whose looping-warren premise fits a map you circle rather than a course you flee along. Kept 1 vs All for its escape gate and separated hunter/hunted spawns, but dropped cover-los because the prompt says you just run rather than hide, and swapped in spawner-npc since the zombie reads as hostile AI needing an origin and patrol ground. Deciding without a user: the zombie is an NPC pursuer, and the P2 is genuine here because rooftops and streets are both traversed, so it is not a modifier I can drop.
